results.title: 49ers vs The NFC East: Critical East
results.description: The 49ers will play the NFC East this season, beginning with the Washington Commanders at Levi’s Stadium in Week 6. They’ll then travel to Dallas to face the Cowboys in Week 9, head to the Big Apple for a Week 13 matchup with the New York Giants, and finish the NFC East slate when the Philadelphia Eagles come to the Bay in Week 17.

results.title: Aryna Sabalenka halts US Open match over strong smell
results.description: Aryna Sabalenka had to pause her US Open third-round match against Kamilla Rakhimova after a strong smell started drifting through Louis Armstrong Stadium.

results.title: One Potential Weakness the Vikings Can't Allow the Packers to Exploit in Week 1
results.description: If the Vikings want to emerge victorious in Week 1, they must prevent the Packers from exploiting this glaring offensive weakness.

results.title: Bay FC beaten by Kansas City’s last-minute goal in 2-1 NWSL loss
results.description: Kansas City’s Rocky Rodriguez scored on a left-footed strike from the top of the box that found the net with a minute left.

results.title: Stanford ready to attack bye week to fix issues that led to 45-6 loss to No. 7 Miami
results.description: The Cardinal (1-1) didn’t score on offense and its defense allowed touchdowns on six of Miami’s seven possessions on Friday night.
